statement: Pulse combines traffic, conversion, revenue, AI-source, uptime, and agent-report views in one analytics product.
evidence: Source review confirms dashboard pages and API report routes for traffic, funnels/goals, revenue, AI-source attribution, uptime and scoped agent reports. Existing tracking, funnel-analysis, agent-auth and daily-briefs tests cover related calculations and boundaries; this review does not assert signed-in end-to-end verification.

statement: The first-party Pulse tracker does not set visitor cookies by default and respects Do Not Track.
evidence: Reviewed public/t.js: it exits for navigator/window Do Not Track before sending, stores temporary visit identifiers in sessionStorage and contains no cookie writes. src/lib/analytics-privacy.test.ts covers referrer minimization; the cookie/DNT statement is verified from tracker source.

statement: Self-managed and hosted Pulse access are private-preview options with no public purchase or fixed-price offer.
evidence: Reviewed src/app/pricing/page.tsx and src/app/self-host/page.tsx: self-managed and managed options are invitation-only private previews with no checkout, fixed-price or public-registration offer. src/lib/public-claims.test.ts guards unsupported public offers and registration links.

statement: Pulse does not publish a reusable demo account; evaluation access is invitation-only.
evidence: Reviewed src/app/demo/page.tsx: noindex invitation-only notice with no credentials. src/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx and src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts fail closed unless explicitly enabled; src/lib/auth.ts applies the verified-email/existing-account Google gate. src/lib/registration.test.ts covers default-closed registration and existing verified Google access.
